# ledger_payment_match (Data Source)

These are derived reports, not configuration. Balances and bank transaction details are bank-sourced facts from the connected provider; they are kept apart from the person's own corrections (manual payments, status overrides, match decisions) and are not edited here. One payment match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ledger_payment_match" "one" {
  id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZ002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The payment match identifier (a ULID).

### Read-Only

- `amount` (Attributes) The amount of the transaction assigned to the occurrence. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--amount))
- `bank_text_redacted` (Boolean) Whether the bank's description text was redacted.
- `counts_as_evidence` (Boolean) Whether the match counts as payment evidence.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created.
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who created it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `decided_at` (String) When, or null.
- `decided_by` (Attributes) Who decided it, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--decided_by))
- `history` (Attributes List) What happened to the match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `needs_review` (Boolean) Whether a person should review it.
- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence it pays.
- `origin` (String) auto_rule, model_suggestion or user.
- `reason` (String) The reason given, or null.
- `state` (String) suggested, confirmed, rejected or reversed.
- `transaction` (Attributes) The bank transaction (a bank-sourced fact). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transaction))
- `transaction_id` (String) The bank transaction.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed.
- `version` (Number) The version.

<a id="nestedatt--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Exact decimal amount as a string, in the scale Ledger stores it. Never a floating-point number.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of amount.


<a id="nestedatt--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `created_by`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) user, token or system.
- `user_id` (String) The user, when there is one.
- `via` (String) session, token, mcp or system.


<a id="nestedatt--decided_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `decided_by`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) user, token or system.
- `user_id` (String) The user, when there is one.
- `via` (String) session, token, mcp or system.


<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) suggested, confirmed, rejected, unmatched, corrected, reversed or unconfirmed.
- `amount` (Attributes) The amount then. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history--amount))
- `at` (String) When.
- `by` (Attributes) Who. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history--by))
- `reason` (String) The reason, or null.
- `replaced_manual_payment_ids` (List of String) Manual payments it replaced.
- `restored_manual_payment_ids` (List of String) Manual payments it restored.
- `state` (String) The state after it.

<a id="nestedatt--history--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history.amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Exact decimal amount as a string, in the scale Ledger stores it. Never a floating-point number.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of amount.


<a id="nestedatt--history--by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history.by`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) user, token or system.
- `user_id` (String) The user, when there is one.
- `via` (String) session, token, mcp or system.



<a id="nestedatt--transaction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transaction`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The account.
- `amount` (Attributes) The amount; may be negative. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transaction--amount))
- `booking_date` (String) Or null.
- `booking_status` (String) booked, pending, cancelled or other.
- `countable` (Boolean) Whether it can count as evidence.
- `counterparty` (String) The counterparty, or null.
- `date` (String) The transaction date.
- `description` (String) The bank's text, or null when redacted.
- `id` (String) The transaction identifier.
- `no_longer_reported_at` (String) When the bank stopped reporting it, or null.
- `provider` (String) The banking provider.
- `source` (String) Always bank.
- `superseded_by` (String) A transaction that replaced it, or null.
- `value_date` (String) Or null.

Read-Only:
